topics.definition: Document databases store data as self-contained documents instead of rows and tables.
tips: Each document can have a different structure.

topics.definition: Documents are commonly represented as JSON or BSON objects.
tips: BSON extends JSON with additional data types.

topics.definition: MongoDB is a popular document-oriented NoSQL database.
tips: Use collections to organize related documents.

topics.definition: A collection is a group of related documents.
tips: Collections are similar to tables in SQL.

topics.definition: Queries retrieve documents that match specified conditions.
tips: Filter only the data you need.

topics.definition: The aggregation pipeline processes documents through multiple stages.
tips: Use aggregation for analytics and reporting.

topics.definition: Design documents around application access patterns and monitor performance.
